title: Open lobbies are Friday 19th of October at 20:00 CET! Race against me in MSFS 2024 NCAR
description:
🏁 MSFS 2024 Community Race Night is LIVE! 🏁

Sim Update 7 is out, and the National Championship Air Races are ready for all of us. No more empty lobbies or solo time trials—tonight we are opening the gates and flying head-to-head in full community multiplayer heats! 

Whether you're strapping into a P-51D Mustang, wrestling an L-39 at 500 knots, or watching the chaos live from the chat, welcome to the grid!

--------------------------------------------------
🎮 HOW TO JOIN THE RACE:
--------------------------------------------------
1. Launch Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.
2. Go to: Activities - National Championship Air Races.
3. Check your Server: Set Multiplayer to "West Europe".
4. Search Lobby: Look for "HFS Lobby" (Host: High in the FlightSim Sky).
5. Voice Comms: Jump into our Discord voice channel to call out overtakes, penalties, and lobby turns: https://discord.gg/J3tZyhceUM

--------------------------------------------------
⏱️ TONIGHT'S HEAT ROTATION:
--------------------------------------------------
• Heat 1: T-6 Texan Class – Tight pylon turns, dirty wake, pure formation brawling.
• Heat 2: Unlimited Class (P-51D Mustang) – Full-throttle warbird speed.
• Heat 3: Jet Class (L-39 Albatros) – High-G racing line management.
• Heat 4: Biplane Class (Pitts S-1S) – Knife-edge precision and fast roll rates.
• Bonus: STOL Drag Challenge – Quick stops, zero ground loops!

*Between heats, live chat polls will decide track locations (Reno vs. Roswell) and rematch requests!*

--------------------------------------------------
⚙️ FLIGHT CONTROLS & HARDWARE:
--------------------------------------------------
• Joystick: MOZA AB6 Force Feedback Base
• Hardware Profiles: Download all custom MOZA FFB curves and control layouts used tonight directly from my website:
👉 https://highintheflightsimsky.nl

--------------------------------------------------
💬 CHAT RULES:
--------------------------------------------------
• Be respectful to fellow racers and chatters.
• Keep friendly banter clean—what happens on the pylon line stays on the pylon line!
• Have fun and don't cut the pylons (+10s penalty)!

If you enjoy the stream, don't forget to hit Like and Subscribe for more MSFS 2024 multiplayer events, hardware guides, and tutorials!

#MSFS2024 #AirRaces #MicrosoftFlightSimulator #FlightSim #Livestream #Multiplayer #HighInTheFlightSimSky
